title: Repository Discovery
summary: Complete product repository inventory, dependency graph, unused/dead heuristics, configs, entry points, integrations.

entries.statement: Product source co-located with AIOS control plane; product scan covers 430 files under app/components/lib/docs/scripts/supabase/public + root configs.
15 root configuration/lock files inventoried (secrets in .env.local not opened).
88 runtime entry points (pages, layouts, routes, actions, proxy).
32 code files not reachable from entry-point import graph (heuristic; may include dynamically imported or type-only).
31 code files with zero static importers and not entry points.

Runtime deps (20): @hookform/resolvers, @radix-ui/react-slot, @supabase/ssr, @supabase/supabase-js, @tanstack/react-query, class-variance-authority, clsx, date-fns, lucide-react, next, next-themes, radix-ui, react, react-dom, react-hook-form, recharts, sonner, tailwind-merge, zod, zustand. DevDeps (9): @tailwindcss/postcss, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom, eslint, eslint-config-next, eslint-plugin-unused-imports, tailwindcss, typescript.

dead_code_heuristic.caveat: Dynamic import(), re-exports, and string-based paths may produce false positives.
